scoring.primary_quantity: nonzero expected quantity must appear as its own number in the text window after the product name and before the next labeled product
scoring.zeros: labeled, excluded from primary quantity accuracy
scoring.unresolved: not written into the ground-truth files, so they are not scored
scoring.fuzzy: compact alphanumeric containment is reported and is not counted as exact product accuracy
scoring.document_independence: fields inside one document are dependent; McNemar here is field-level and overstates precision
